title: Woody Marks on David Montgomery trade: Looking to have same joy he had with Jahmyr Gibbs

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Woody Marks on David Montgomery trade: Looking to have same joy he had with Jahmyr Gibbs
sources.description: The Texans are set to add running back David Montgomery in a trade with the Lions when the new league year starts next week and their leading rusher for 2025 says he's looking forward to having Montgomery in Houston.
